caption:
Be grateful for everything 💚🙏

#healthybodyhealthymind #blessings #blessyourheart #blessingsonblessings
transcript: If you still see your mother's name light up your phone, that is not ordinary. That is a blessing. If your father still calls you, even for no reason at all, that is a blessing. If your sibling sends you nonsense, jokes, or random thoughts, that is life reaching out to you. That is a blessing. If your grandparents still remembers your name, your face, your voice, that is a quiet miracle. If a friend calls just to check in, not because they need something, but because they care, that is a blessing. If someone prays for you when you are not in the room, that is protection you cannot see. If someone says, call me when you get home, they are saying, your life matters to me. Do not rush past these moments. Do not treat them as normal, because one day the phone will be quiet. The messages will stop, the names will no longer appear, and you will understand these were never small things. These were the riches of life, so cherish them. While they are still here, if this message touched your heart, save it, and share it with someone you love, before the silence teaches the lesson instead.
